description: No test file to run and no `--passWithNoTests`, under Jest 30.5.2 (B23b review): Jest prints its `No tests found` message and exits 1 before it schedules anything, so no coverage report is written, no threshold is checked and no `Jest: ` line is printed. The pair of `coverage/threshold-no-tests`. Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage-thresholds.test.ts`.
